name: king and queen

measure.quantity: the region's squares off the edge (the squares their king walks to without stepping onto a square we attack), then our king's distance to the front zone, then the region's size
measure.floor: a region of at most two squares: the net, a forced mate within three moves searched in full

note: The lone king is driven to the edge by a measure that falls against every reply, each move certified on the board; that every position of the frame has a certificate is checked, not proved (mating.rs, commit d7f82ae4, no plan section).
